selected_mechanisms.root_cause: updateTSSAddress gated only by onlyTSSUpdater; sets TSSAddress unconditionally to any non-zero address. A compromised/malicious TSSAddressUpdater replaces TSSAddress with attacker address, then controls withdraw (drain), whitelist, pause, fee. Single key redirects all custody authority with no on-chain confirmation from existing TSSAddress.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Compromised or malicious TSSAddressUpdater key (single key, no on-chain multisig/timelock).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker (as TSSAddressUpdater) calls updateTSSAddress(attacker_addr). 2. TSSAddress=attacker. 3. Attacker calls withdraw(attacker, asset, fullBalance) — passes onlyTSS + whitelisted. 4. All custody drained.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: All depositors — full balance of every whitelisted token drainable.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Architectural single point of failure: one compromised key controls entire custody; withdraw is onlyTSS with no extra guard. Direct, total fund loss relative to new TSSAddress.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: whitelist()/unwhitelist() gated solely by onlyTSS. TSS can unwhitelist every token, permanently bricking deposit() and withdraw() (both check whitelisted). No minimum-whitelist invariant, no timelock. Permanent fund lock even for legitimate TSS.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. TSS calls unwhitelist(asset) for every token. 2. deposit() reverts NotWhitelisted. 3. withdraw() reverts NotWhitelisted. 4. Funds permanently locked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: All users with funds deposited — funds locked indefinitely.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Distinct mechanism (whitelisted mapping); different impact (fund locking, not theft). Since withdraw also checks whitelisted, even legitimate TSS cannot rescue funds — potential permanent fund lock at HIGH.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: missing on-chain multisig/timelock on updateTSSAddress / renounceTSSAddressUpdater — single TSS key compromise post-renounce allows immediate replacement
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: renounceTSSAddressUpdater() sets updater=TSSAddress, no timelock; updateTSSAddress() no confirmation; single-tx single-key.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether off-chain TSS multi-party key management mitigates on-chain single-key risk — not determinable from source.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: All custody users if TSS key compromised post-renounce.

rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Any EOA other than updater rejected before state change.

impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Attacker is privileged updater, but impact hits ALL third-party depositors; gains external value; griefing path permanently locks third-party funds; not dust/self-funded/timing-only.
